meta.title: MotionGX — Motion videos in your brand
meta.description: Make on-brand motion-graphics videos in minutes.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

login.title: Motion videos in your brand
login.subtitle: Sign in with your email and we'll send you a login link. No password.
login.sentHint: Open your email ({email}) and click the link to sign in.
login.linkError: That link is invalid or expired. Request a new one.

dashboard.heroSub: Describe your idea, pick a goal, format and dialect. We handle the rest — your colors, fonts and logo in every video.
dashboard.noCompanies: No companies yet. Add your first one from its website.
dashboard.noVideos: No videos yet. Start your first one.

companies.title: Add a company from its website
companies.subtitle: Paste the website and we'll pull the logo, colors, fonts and tone. Edit anything before saving.
companies.name: Company name
companies.fillManually: We couldn't get: {steps}. Fill them in before saving.
companies.cachedNote: Using the saved reading of this website.
companies.reviewNote: Review the brand and edit anything before saving.
companies.nameCheckBody: The logo and the site show different names. Pick the name your videos should use:
companies.factsHint: Scripts only use these facts — and no numbers that aren't on the site.
companies.noNumbers: No numbers — videos won't show stats.
companies.editSubtitle: Edit the brand and the facts scripts rely on, or press "Re-read website" to read the site again.
companies.liveHint: Signing up inside the product and touring its features takes about 10 minutes. If you leave, enter the same link again to pick it up.
companies.filesDemoHint: Images from the agent's test drive (sample products, test orders) — not brand photos, never used as photos in videos.

videos.title: New video
videos.subtitle: Tell us what you want — we write the script and design the scenes in your brand.
videos.briefPlaceholder: e.g. A short video showing Mantoog turns a product link into a full store, first month free.
videos.dialectHint: The video language is separate from the interface language.
videos.priceNote: Billed on {seconds}s. Drafts and previews are free; failed exports are refunded.

studio.requestPlaceholder: e.g. Make scene three faster and the logo bigger.
studio.exportQueued: Export queued — {price} charged to your wallet.
studio.insufficient: Not enough balance to export. Top up your wallet first.
studio.rewritten: Scene rewritten and saved as version {n}.
studio.renderDone: Your video is ready to download.
studio.renderFailed: The export failed — the charge was refunded to your wallet.
studio.anotherDirectionHint: A brand-new concept and animation. Free.
studio.directionStarted: Working on a fresh direction — this takes a few minutes.
studio.directionFailed: That direction didn't pass our quality check. Your current version is unchanged — try another direction.
studio.editStarted: Applying your change — it goes through the same quality check.
studio.editFailed: We couldn't apply that change cleanly, so the last good version stays. Try wording it differently.
studio.undoFailed: We couldn't restore the previous version. Try again.
studio.editStale: The video changed before your edit was applied, so we didn't apply it. Ask again on the current version.
studio.requestHint: Changes the animation itself, then re-checks the whole layout.
studio.needsDirection: This direction didn't pass our quality check. Try another direction — it's free.
studio.noComposition: This video doesn't have an animation yet.
studio.generatingHint: Usually under a minute. You can leave this page.
studio.previewError: The preview hit an error. Try another direction.
studio.stage_plan: The creative director is planning the film…
studio.codeHint: We're signing up on your website to film the app. Enter the code sent to {to}.
studio.liveHint: The first video for a company takes ~10 min, later ones ~1 min. You can leave this page.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.topUpHint: The amount is locked in USD at top-up time.
wallet.priceRounding: Billed per second, rounded up to the next 5 seconds.
wallet.priceDrafts: Drafts and previews are free. You only pay on export.
wallet.priceRefund: If an export fails, you're refunded automatically.

aiErrors.rate_limited: You've hit the limit of 30 AI requests per workspace per hour. Try again a bit later.
aiErrors.not_configured: AI isn't connected yet. Contact your account admin.
aiErrors.ai_failed: The AI didn't respond. Please try again.
aiErrors.ai_invalid: The AI returned an invalid result. Please try again.
aiErrors.scrape_failed: We couldn't read that website. Fill in the details yourself or try again.

art.hero: Film strip, play button and pen-tool node

posts.title: Your posts
posts.subtitle: Text and visuals for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn and X — written in your brand's voice, designed from its real identity.
posts.empty: No posts yet. Describe your first one and we'll write and design it.
posts.noCompany: Add a company first — posts are made from its brand.
posts.newSubtitle: Say what the post is about. We write the text for each platform and design the images from your brand.

typeHints.single: One designed image and the text for each platform.
typeHints.carousel: Several slides that tell one story, and the text.
typeHints.text: Only the text — for X and LinkedIn, or any platform.

posts.platformsHint: Pick one or more. Each gets its own text and image size.
posts.briefPlaceholder: e.g. Our 0% commission offer for new stores — friendly, short, with a clear call to sign up.
posts.aiHint: AI makes scenes and illustrations without any text in them; your words, logo and real screens go on top.
posts.priceNote: Charged once, on the first download. Creating the post and changing it are free.
posts.briefRequired: Describe what the post is about.
posts.working: We're making your post — this takes about a minute or two.
posts.failed: We couldn't make this post. Try again or change the description.
posts.noCapture: This company has no brand capture yet. Open it in Companies and capture its brand first.
posts.changeFailed: The change didn't go through — the previous version is unchanged.
posts.chargedNote: Downloads of this post are free from now on.
posts.insufficient: Not enough balance for this download — top up your wallet.
posts.requestPlaceholder: e.g. Make the headline shorter and use the phone screen of the product page.
